name: search-trigger
purpose: The field-shaped button in a top bar that opens search: a magnifier, a muted label (`Search` by default) and the keycap of the shortcut that opens the same palette (`⌘K` on macOS, `Ctrl K` elsewhere, drawn by `Kbd`). It looks like an input so the bar reads "you can search here", but it is one `<button>` that emits `open` — on click and on the shortcut itself, which it binds on the window unless a mounted `Command` already listens for it. The consumer opens `Command` (or its own search) from `open`. Every app header — console, demo, docs and site — carries one: it is the single way search is offered in a top bar. With `collapsible` it folds to the magnifier alone inside a narrow container (with its label as a tooltip), so one element serves the wide and the narrow bar.
useWhen: The search entry of every app header — console, demo, docs or site top bar (`GlobalHeader.Right`) — that opens the `Command` palette or a search dialog. A header without it is incomplete.
Anywhere a shortcut-backed launcher should look like a field without being one.
avoidWhen: To type a query in place (filter a list, search a table) → use `Input` with a search icon, `PropertyFilter`, or the `Table` search part.
For the palette itself → use `Command`; this only opens it.
For an icon-only toolbar action that is not search → use `IconButton`.
related: Command` — the palette this button opens; when it is mounted it owns the global ⌘K / Ctrl+K listener and `v-model:open`, and the trigger stands its own listener down.
Kbd` — draws the keycap with the OS-aware modifier glyph.
IconButton` — the shape the trigger folds to when `collapsible` and the container is narrow.
Tooltip` — shows the label over the folded magnifier on hover and focus.
GlobalHeader` — the bar it sits in, usually in `GlobalHeader.Right`.
bestPractices: Wire `@open` to the same state the shortcut opens (`<Command v-model:open="open">`), so the button and ⌘K never disagree. Without a `Command` on the page, `@open` also fires on ⌘K / Ctrl K, so a custom search dialog gets the shortcut for free.
Keep `shortcut` equal to the key the `Command` root listens for (`K`), or clear it (`shortcut=""`) when no shortcut exists.
Do not hand-roll the field (`<button>` + magnifier + `Kbd`) or put a bare magnifier `IconButton` in a header: the `webkit/header-search-trigger` lint rule flags both.

With `collapsible`, put the bar inside an `@container` (the header blocks do); the trigger folds while that container is narrower than 47rem (752 px, the `--container-2xl` token) and without a container it stays folded. Do not add your own breakpoint around it: 47rem is the one threshold every header uses.
With `collapsible`, the button sits inside the `Tooltip` wrapper, so put layout classes (`ms-auto`, `order-*`) on a parent, not on the trigger.
Name the target in the label when the scope is narrow (`Search docs`); the label is also the accessible name.

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible muted text and accessible name; empty uses the catalog's `Search`.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Key that opens search with ⌘ or Ctrl: drawn in the keycap, announced through `aria-keyshortcuts` and bound on the window unless a mounted `Command` already listens for it; empty removes all three.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Folds to the magnifier alone while the nearest container is narrower than 47rem (752px, the `--container-2xl` token); the label stays the accessible name and shows as a tooltip on hover and focus.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables the button and its shortcut; `open` is not emitted.

events.name: open
events.notes: Fires when the button is activated (pointer, Enter or Space) and on ⌘K / Ctrl K when no mounted `Command` claims that shortcut; not while `disabled`.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Command from '@aziontech/webkit/command'
  import SearchTrigger from '@aziontech/webkit/search-trigger'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const open = ref(false)
  const pages = ['Workloads', 'Applications', 'Functions', 'Firewall']
</script>

<template>
  <SearchTrigger @open="open = true" />
  <Command
    v-model:open="open"
    shortcut="meta+k"
    @select="open = false"
  >
    <Command.Input placeholder="Search pages" />
    <Command.List>
      <Command.Empty>No results.</Command.Empty>
      <Command.Group heading="Pages">
        <Command.Item
          v-for="page in pages"
          :key="page"
          :value="page"
          >{{ page }}</Command.Item
        >
      </Command.Group>
    </Command.List>
  </Command>
</template>
